# bintables/fn

> Function: label, standard stack frame, body, default return 0.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/fn.pkg) · translates [std/fn](../std/fn.md)

The label is `pk_<name>`. `{frame}` is the space for the function's local
variables, rounded to 16 bytes.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
{name.label}:
push rbp
mov rbp, rsp
sub rsp, {frame}
{body}
xor eax, eax
leave
ret
```
